semiconductor_relevance: High — Fujian Deer Technology Corp. specializes in fluorochemical materials and specialty gases critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Fujian Deer Technology Corp. is a national high-tech enterprise focused on the research, development, and production of fluorine-containing materials and specialty gases for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include high-purity wet electronic chemicals essential for etching and cleaning in advanced semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Production of high-purity hydrofluoric acid and etching solutions
Lithium battery materials for energy storage
Wet electronic chemicals for advanced manufacturing processes

regional_presence.China: Fujian Deer Technology Corp. is a leading domestic manufacturer of fluorinated electronic gases in China.
